name: Serpent Ward

source.title: Pathfinder #170: Spoken on the Song Wind

disable: DC 26 Thievery check (expert) or DC 24 Occultism check (expert) to deactivate the magical trigger

items.name: Curse the Intruders
items.text:
Trigger The trapped door is opened other than by a serpentfolk

---

Effect Hissing, illusionary snakes leap from the door. Each living creature within 30 feet is subjected to the curse of potent poison. If a living creature opened the door, that creature must roll its saving throw against the curse twice and take the worse result (this is a misfortune effect).

---

Curse of Potent Poison (uncommon, curse, magical) CURSE 5

This curse magically speeds poison through your body.

Saving Throw DC 20 Will save

---

Effect You take a -1 status penalty to Fortitude saves and you gain weakness 3 to poison (if you already have weakness to poison, increase it by 3). The curse remains until removed by Cleanse Affliction or similar magic.

Effect: Curse of Potent Poison

text: Illusionary snakes erupt from the trapped door, inflicting a venomous curse on intruders.
